summary.text: Michael Rohl is a Republican state senator from South Dakota Senate District 1 who assumed office in January 2021 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
A hotel general manager by profession, he has an accounting degree from Drake University.

paragraphs.text: Michael Rohl earned a degree in accounting from Drake University, and his career experience includes working as a general manager of hotel chains.
Rohl assumed office in the South Dakota State Senate on January 12, 2021, succeeding Democrat Susan Wismer.
In the 2025-2026 session he is assigned to the Senate Agriculture and Natural Resources Committee and the Senate Local Government Committee.
